mapper.select: SELECT start_date as startDate, end_date as endDate, content, IF(checked = 1, TRUE, FALSE) as completed FROM planner WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND start_date = DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL (DAYOFWEEK(CURDATE()) - 1) DAY) AND end_date = DATE_ADD(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL (DAYOFWEEK(CURDATE()) - 1) DAY), INTERVAL 6 DAY)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO planner (user_id, start_date, end_date, content, checked) VALUES (#{userId}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{content}, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT start_date AS startDate, end_date AS endDate, content FROM planner WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND ( start_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND DATE_ADD(#{startDate}, INTERVAL 6 DAY) OR end_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND DATE_ADD(#{startDate}, INTERVAL 6 DAY) OR (start_date = #{startDate} AND end_date >= DATE_ADD(#{startDate}, INTERVAL 6 DAY)) )
